name: Greater Word Focus
body:
Prerequisite(s) Word Focus Choose an Identifying Word to which you have already applied the Word Focus feat. Any Words you speak using that Identifying Word are very difficult to resist.

Benefit(s): Add +1 to the Difficulty Class for all saving throws against Words using the Identifying Word you select. This bonus stacks with the bonus from Word Focus.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new Identifying Word to which you have already applied the Word Focus feat.

Speaker: A Pathfinder 1e class designed for use in the Lost Lands, © 2021, Michael Mars, Author Michael Mars Russell
